action.description: guide: what create accepts (angles, personas, approved people, places and products, concepts, effects, templates, layouts, edits, shortcuts). inspect: the typed graph (view). create: the brand's director writes reels or stills from guidance. create_spec: a reel you authored shot by shot. create_stills: statics or a carousel you authored. act: a graph action (Elements, characters, opening frames, save, generate, run, review). style_draft: draft a brand style. recompose: change a made reel's motion overlay at no cost. status: a run and, once rendered, its reel.

portfolio_id.description: guide: an Optimizer portfolio, to list its personas and winning angles.

schema.description: guide: also return the create_spec, create_stills and style_draft schemas and rules (large).

view.description: inspect: elements (named Character/Scene/Product Elements), facts (approved brand facts), seeds (proven seeds), schema (graph payload schemas), content / compile (a saved content spec, with id and revision), run (a run, with id), poses (floor position ids for poseId).

id.description: inspect: the content or run id the view reads.

guidance.description: create: ids and choices from action=guide; the director writes every hook, line and CTA from the brand's data.

reels.description: How many vertical reels to make.

stills.description: How many still sets (a static or a small carousel) to make.

language.description: ISO 639-1 code every spoken and written word is in: "es", "en".

portfolioId.description: Paid: the Optimizer portfolio whose audience and winning ads ground the work.

recommendationId.description: Paid: an Optimizer recommendation; the work sells that recommendation's offer.

persona.description: Who the creative speaks to: a persona id listed by view=guidance.

gender.description: Casting constraint: the gender everyone cast shares (the approved actresses → female). Personas are derived within it.

angleIds.description: The winning angles to sell on: angle ids listed by view=guidance.

characterElementIds.description: The identity lock: approved people the director casts from, and only from; each reel is one of them, the same person in every shot. Ids from view=guidance only.

sceneElementIds.description: Approved places to shoot in. Ids from view=guidance only.

productElementIds.description: The product lock: approved products every reel and still shows, the same product in every shot it appears in. Ids from view=guidance only.

referenceAssetIds.description: Library image assets to use as visual references; role says what each image controls.

unsplashPhotos.description: Optional Unsplash photo ids selected from unsplash_search; source photos guide the scene, style or pose only.

grammar.description: Every reel's story shape: a concept id from view=guidance concepts (offer-direct, the default, is the offer in the hook). With vary=grammar, the concept to move the base to.

baseRecommendationId.description: Paid: double down on this winning recommendation's creative, changing one thing (vary). Give at most one base.

baseRunId.description: An accepted headless output to double down on: its run id, with baseOutputId.

baseOutputId.description: The accepted output id inside baseRunId.

vary.description: The ONE thing each variant changes against its base (hook, face, location, grammar or effect). The base is baseRecommendationId, baseRunId+baseOutputId, or else the one winning angle in angleIds. With a base and no vary, the ad's own numbers pick it.

effectId.description: An effect over the footage, never the type (view=guidance effects, or the brand's approved styles). With vary=effect and a base, the effect to re-style the base's own takes in, at no generation cost.

templateId.description: The reel's type and motion template (view=guidance templates); absent, the director picks.

stillLayout.description: A still's layout family (view=guidance layouts); absent, the director picks.

pacing.description: Locks the reel's edit (view=guidance edits). none: spoken beats only. steady, build, stutter or drop-hit: a fast-cut montage of silent action shots cut on the beat of a music bed between the spoken hook and the spoken CTA; build runs 1 s cuts down to 0.05 s into the drop. Absent, the director picks.

layout.description: Locks how the montage draws its cuts (view=guidance edits). cut: each fills the frame. collage: each snaps in as a tile in its own section of one canvas and stays, the photo-wall open of an event recap. collage with no pacing locks build. Absent, cut.

conceptVariantId.description: A brand's approved concept variant (view=guidance); its base concept is the grammar.

motionOverlay.description: Locks an editable motion overlay: the reel's CTA, type cards, burst words and display words are drawn as motion a later spoken change ("stagger the CTA") re-composes at no cost. Absent, the type is burned in.

referenceUrl.description: A reference reel (an Instagram reel or a video link): its tempo, its average shot length and a few of its frames guide the edit and the shots. Its footage, people, audio and text are never used.

music.description: What a montage reel's music bed sounds like: genre, instruments, energy. Its tempo is the reference's when one is given.

cta.description: The closing call to action in the brief's own words, at most 24 characters (e.g. "Shop the jacket"). Absent, it comes from the brand's winning copy.

withoutCta.description: true: the reel ends with no call to action (it wins over cta).

storyboard.description: Your own shot list for a montage concept (lookbook): one shot per entry, in order, at most 8 distinct places. Absent, the director writes it (a reference reel's keyframes, shot for shot, when there is one); with a reference reel, the reel keeps only its tempo.

place.description: Where, written to be seen: the light, the time of day, the weather, the scale ("a salt flat at blue hour under a vast sky").

camera.description: The framing and move ("drone push over the ridge", "waist-up orbit").

reviewStoryboard.description: true: stop at the storyboard. Each reel is directed and only its opening stills are made (512px for a lookbook), returned as a contact sheet and a shot list with a storyboardId; no video. Reels only.

storyboardId.description: Make a reviewed storyboard exactly as it was shown, on its own stills: every other field is ignored. Change it instead by calling again with reviewStoryboard and an edited storyboard.

direction.description: Optional steer on emphasis or tone, at most 400 characters. Never copy, a claim, a price or an offer: those come from the data.

request_json.description: create_spec: the reel request as JSON (delivery.edit makes it a fast cut or a collage). create_stills: the still request as JSON. Their schemas: action=guide with schema=true.

graph_action.description: act: which graph action; its payload schema is inspect view=schema.

payload_json.description: act: the graph action payload as JSON. style_draft: the style draft as JSON.

shortcuts.description: Catalog shortcut slugs without the slash (goldenhour, 35mmfilm, noir) or a brand skill slug, only when the user asked for them: each adds its light, camera or finish direction to every shot or slide. Of two conflicting shortcuts the later wins. The result lists which applied and which are unknown.

brandBook.description: On by default: the brand book's imagery, personality and saved generation defaults direct every shot or slide. The saved logo preference guides inclusion; any logo needs an approved reference. Set false only when the brief is deliberately off-brand, and tell the user.

max_usd.description: Required on every call that can spend (create, create_spec, create_stills, and act prepare_reference / prepare_character / generate / prepare_start_frame / run): the most it may spend in USD, refused before any spend when its own budget is higher.

dry_run.description: create: direct only and return the plans; nothing is generated or spent beyond model tokens.

run_id.description: status: a run id from a create result.

reel_asset_id.description: recompose: the made reel (status asset_id), rendered with motionOverlay=true.

ops_json.description: A JSON array of 1 to 50 HyperFrames motion ops on the reel overlay, in reel seconds, naming its animations (cta, cta-words, card-1, card-1-title, card-1-lines, burst-1, display-word-1 …), e.g. [{"type":"stagger","animationId":"cta-words","eachSec":0.08}]
